title: Run-length encode (flush the last run)
prompt:
Encode runs as `<char><count>`: "aaabbbcc" → "a3b3c2". Runs of length 1 still get the count. Implement `process(String s)` (empty string encodes to the empty string).

This is the flush trap: the final run ends at the loop's last index, not inside it.

tests.name: run-length encoding
tests.hint: Count runs; when the char changes (or the loop ends), append charAt(i-1) and the count.
